Summary: Company News Ingestion & Risk-Based Ranking for Professional Insurance Assessment
Description: Fetch a target company's news feed via Alpha Vantage, dedupe it, then score and rank each article by its relevance/severity to the company's professional insurance risk. Output structured risk signals to Azure SQL for consumption by the Underwriting Intelligence UI, supporting underwriting risk assessment. All data (raw news, metadata, scoring output) is persisted in Azure SQL.
Acceptance Criteria: News can be fetched by ticker with title, summary, source, URL, published time, and Alpha Vantage sentiment/relevance fields; duplicates (same event across sources/repeat pushes) deduped before storage; each article scored across professional insurance risk dimensions (litigation/E&O, regulatory, financial distress, governance, operational) with an overall risk score; articles ranked by risk score descending, queryable by ticker/time window; results written to Azure SQL with traceability (ticker, article_id, run timestamp, model version); UI can retrieve the ranked news list via the BFF.

Parent: Company News Ingestion & Risk-Based Ranking for Professional Insurance Assessment
Description: Integrate the Alpha Vantage NEWS_SENTIMENT endpoint. Fetch by ticker (with optional time_from/time_to window), parse title, summary, source, URL, published time, and ticker-level relevance/sentiment. Handle pagination, API key, and rate limits. Write raw news and metadata to an Azure SQL staging table.
Acceptance Criteria: Raw news and metadata persisted to Azure SQL; pagination and rate limits handled; API key secured; ticker-level relevance/sentiment captured.

Parent: Company News Ingestion & Risk-Based Ranking for Professional Insurance Assessment
Description: Identify duplicate coverage of the same event across sources using URL normalization plus title/summary similarity (normalization + hash or embedding similarity threshold). Keep a representative article and record merged sources. Persist dedup results to Azure SQL.
Acceptance Criteria: Duplicate articles grouped and deduped; representative article retained; merged source references recorded; dedup group id stored.

Parent: Company News Ingestion & Risk-Based Ranking for Professional Insurance Assessment
Description: Design a company_news table (article_id, ticker, title, summary, source, url, published_at, av_relevance, av_sentiment, dedup_group_id) and a news_risk_score table (article_id, ticker, risk dimensions, overall_risk_score, rationale, model_version, created_at). Add indexes to support ranking queries by ticker + risk_score.
Acceptance Criteria: Tables created with keys and indexes; all news and scoring stored in Azure SQL only; queryable and sortable by ticker and risk_score.

Acceptance Criteria: Prompt returns valid JSON parsed safely; schema validated; overall risk score and rationale produced per article; batch scoring supported.

Acceptance Criteria: Endpoint returns risk-ranked news with rationale by ticker/time window; integrated with existing BFF auth.
